errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия започва при стойност около 120 и показва леко растеж до около 125 към 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the orange line shows slight growth to about 125 by 2022. However, the line shows a very slight increase between 2018 and 2020, and then decreases, ending in 2022 at a value very close to its starting value of approximately 122. The overall trend is flat, not one of growth.
The description states that the gray line drops to about 155 in 2020. The data point for the gray line in 2020 is visibly above the 160 gridline, at a value of approximately 163.
The description uses the redundant phrase "сиво-сив линия" (gray-gray line) instead of the standard "сива линия" (gray line).
